```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        if pd.isna(value):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(float(value), 1) if metric in ("share",) else (
                float(value) if metric == "rank" else round(float(value), 2)),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)

    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (tw - lw) / lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (tw - ly) / ly * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", u_tw, "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", o_tw, "sum(Orders_TW)")

    # Top 5 entities by revenue this week
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for entity")
    if len(top) > 0:
        t1 = top.iloc[0]
        add(t1["Entity"], "share", "TW", t1["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(t1["Share_Pct"])
            else (t1["Revenue_TW"] / tw * 100 if tw else np.nan),
            "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        add(t1["Entity"], "rank", "TW", t1["Rank"], "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")
    if tw:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tw * 100,
            "sum(top5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # Biggest WoW movers by absolute revenue change
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    gain = d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(3)
    drop = d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=True).head(3)
    for _, r in gain.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    for _, r in drop.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # Biggest WoW percent movers among material entities (revenue >= median of top half)
    mat = d[d["Revenue_LW"] >= d["Revenue_LW"].quantile(0.75)].dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    for _, r in mat.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
    for _, r in mat.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=True).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # Biggest YoY movers by absolute revenue change
    y = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    y["abs_yoy"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
    for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
    for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=True).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
    ym = y[y["Revenue_LY"] >= y["Revenue_LY"].quantile(0.75)].dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    for _, r in ym.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).head(1).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
    for _, r in ym.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=True).head(1).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # Volume leaders
    uu = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"]).sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).head(1)
    for _, r in uu.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", r["Units_TW"], "Units_TW for entity")
    oo = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"]).sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).head(1)
    for _, r in oo.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "orders", "TW", r["Orders_TW"], "Orders_TW for entity")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


main()
```
